text: 只读取你选择分享的内容，数据仅对工作空间可见，不会用于为其他人训练模型。
Verity reads only what you choose to share, keeps it private to your workspace, and never uses it to train models for anyone else.
1. 我们收集什么
1. What we collect
我们收集你提供的账户信息，例如姓名、工作邮箱和公司。接入工具时，只读取你选择分享的文件夹、频道或记录。
We collect the account details you give us, such as your name, work email and company. When you connect a tool, we read only the folders, channels or records you choose to share.
注册时填写的账户信息
Account details you enter when you sign up
来自已连接工具的文档和记录
Documents and records from tools you connect
使用数据，例如使用了哪些功能
Usage data, such as which features you use
2. 如何使用信息
2. How we use it
我们使用信息来运行 Verity、提供有来源的回答并保障账户安全。不会使用你的文档为其他人训练模型。
We use your information to run Verity, answer your questions with sources, and keep your account secure. We never use your documents to train models for anyone else.
3. 与谁共享
3. Who we share it with
仅根据书面协议，与帮助运行 Verity 的服务商共享数据，且仅限其必要范围。
We share data only with the providers that help us run Verity, under written agreements, and only as much as each one needs.
欧盟和美国的云托管
Cloud hosting in the EU and US
账户消息的邮件投递
Email delivery for account messages
发票相关的支付处理
Payment processing for invoices
4. 保留多久
4. How long we keep it
账户开启期间保留数据。删除工作空间后，文档会在 30 天内移除，备份在 90 天内清除。
We keep your data for as long as your account is open. When you delete a workspace, we remove its documents within 30 days and its backups within 90.
5. 你的权利
5. Your rights
随时可以申请查看、更正、导出或删除数据。请联系 privacy@verity.example，我们会在 30 天内回复。
You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data at any time. Write to privacy@verity.example and we will reply within 30 days.
6. 政策变更
6. Changes to this policy
若数据处理方式变化，我们会更新本页，并至少在生效前 30 天向工作空间所有者发送邮件。
If we change how we handle your data, we will update this page and email workspace owners at least 30 days before the change takes effect.
文档始终属于你。你可以随时取消，Verity 给出的每个答案都附有可供人工核查的来源。
Your documents stay yours. You can cancel any time, and every answer Verity gives comes with a source a person can check.
1. 使用 Verity
1. Using Verity
你或你的团队使用 Verity 时，适用这些条款。创建工作空间即表示代表所在组织同意这些条款。
These terms apply when you or your team use Verity. By creating a workspace, you agree to them on behalf of your organisation.
2. 你的账户
2. Your account
你负责所邀请的成员，并妥善保管登录信息。怀疑账户遭到滥用时，请立即告知我们。
You are responsible for the people you invite and for keeping sign-in details safe. Tell us straight away if you think your account has been misused.
3. 你的内容
3. Your content
文档属于你。仅为向你提供 Verity 服务而授权我们处理文档，你可以随时移除。
Your documents stay yours. You give us permission to process them only to provide Verity to you, and you can remove them at any time.
我们不出售你的内容
We do not sell your content
不会使用内容训练共享模型
We do not train shared models on it
你可以导出添加的所有内容
You can export everything you add
4. 费用与计费
4. Fees and billing
付费方案按月或按年预付。可以随时取消，方案会持续到已付费周期结束。
Paid plans are billed in advance, monthly or yearly. You can cancel at any time, and your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for.
5. 责任
5. Liability
Verity 展示来源，以便人工核查每个答案。借助它做出的决定仍由你负责，我们的责任以过去 12 个月你支付的费用为限。
Verity shows its sources so a person can check every answer. Decisions you make with it remain yours, and our liability is limited to the fees you paid in the last 12 months.
6. 终止协议
6. Ending the agreement
可以随时关闭工作空间。我们可能暂停违反条款的账户，并说明原因。
You can close your workspace whenever you like. We may suspend accounts that break these terms, and we will tell you why.
我们只使用少量 Cookie 来保持登录和统计访问，不用于广告。
We use a small number of cookies to keep you signed in and count visits. None are used for advertising.
1. 什么是 Cookie
1. What cookies are
Cookie 是网站保存在浏览器中的小文件，帮助网站在再次访问时记住你。
Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. They help a site remember you between visits.
2. 我们使用的 Cookie
2. Cookies we use
我们尽量减少 Cookie，且从不用于广告。
We keep cookies to a minimum and never use them for advertising.
必要 Cookie：保持登录和工作空间安全
Essential: keep you signed in and your workspace secure
偏好 Cookie：记住语言等设置
Preferences: remember settings such as language
分析 Cookie：统计访问，不识别个人身份
Analytics: count visits, without identifying you
3. 如何关闭
3. Turning them off
可以在浏览器设置中拦截或删除 Cookie。必要 Cookie 是 Verity 运行所需，拦截它们会导致退出登录。
You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Essential cookies are needed for Verity to work, so blocking them will sign you out.
4. 有疑问
4. Questions
如对 Cookie 使用有任何问题，请联系 privacy@verity.example。
Write to privacy@verity.example if you have any questions about how we use cookies.
所有内容均加密，访问只读且有日志，每年由独立机构进行测试。
Everything is encrypted, access is read-only and logged, and independent firms test Verity every year.
1. 加密
1. Encryption
传输采用 TLS 1.3，静态存储采用 AES-256 加密，密钥会自动轮换。
Everything is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Encryption keys are rotated automatically.
2. 访问
2. Access
Verity 只以只读权限读取你接入的来源。内部团队访问生产环境需要另一人审批。
Verity reads only what you connect, and only with read access. Inside our team, production access needs a second person to approve it.
基于 SAML 的单点登录
Single sign-on with SAML
基于角色的权限
Role-based permissions
记录每个答案的完整审计日志
Full audit log of every answer
3. 基础设施
3. Infrastructure
运行在欧盟和美国的主流云平台上，具备每日备份和经过测试的恢复流程。
We run on major cloud providers in the EU and US, with daily backups and tested recovery.
4. 测试
4. Testing
独立机构每年测试 Verity，并为研究人员提供公开漏洞披露计划。
Independent firms test Verity every year, and we run a public disclosure programme for researchers.
5. 报告问题
5. Reporting an issue
发现问题请联系 security@verity.example，我们会在一个工作日内回复。
Found a problem? Write to security@verity.example. We reply within one working day.
